summary: NDX hit a record 31,076.44 on a fifth straight gain while SPX closed 0.32% below its August high, even as the 10-year yield reached a 52-week high of 5.315%. PTC +33% on Schneider's $22.6B bid, Brazilian ADRs surged on the election, and OIH and HLTH were the only +3% ETFs. DJI and RUT remain Bearish and only 26.75% of SPX members sit above their 50MA.
